claim_scope: BOTH. CH: the near-side output is the same TX cell and pad before the declared channel (spec/channel/channel_rc.cir adds nothing here). TC: spec/test-configuration.md:72 reads the on-die array skew through the shmoo; this record is the single-lane-pair statistical spread of that skew, pre-layout, not the array measurement and not a wire-bond loopback result
bench: tb_t13.cir: lane A rises, lane B (complement) falls, launched together; skew = lane-B falling minus lane-A rising crossing of the TX pad node (after the driver and its pad ESD cell, no channel, no receiver) at mid-rail
skew_definition: signed difference, limits +-bound, target_sigma 7 each side (DR-0019)

sample_size.basis: 20-draw pilot; the pilot run is the recorded run

result.tail: worst draw 18.3 ps against the +-40 ps (0.04 UI at 1 Gb/s) limit

note: T-13 FAILS the 7-sigma gate (lower confidence bound 5.79 against 7): pooled over the 45-corner grid mean 2.5 ps, sigma 6.2 ps, sigma-to-spec 6.08 against 7. No draw falls outside the limit (worst 18.3 ps against 40); the row fails on the tail the spec asks for (14 sigma peak-to-peak), not on a sampled violation. The distribution is not normal (Anderson-Darling rejected), so the normal-model sigma-to-spec is indicative. Pooled grid, as for T-10. Recorded, not tuned; the limit and the sigma convention are not relaxed. Negative control: an extra 2 pF on lane B's pad (tb_t13_ctl.cir, not design evidence), detected (0 of 900 pass).
